auth.mechanism: optional static bearer token inside DTLS application data
auth.wrong_token: fail closed; session does not enter Established

cases.name: auth-disabled
cases.client_output:
CLIENT reply=ACCEPT protocol=1
CLIENT state=ESTABLISHED auth=disabled

cases.name: auth-correct
cases.client_output:
CLIENT reply=ACCEPT protocol=1
CLIENT reply=AUTH_OK state=ESTABLISHED
cases.server_output:
SERVER received=control.Hello reply=control.Accept state=1
SERVER received=control.Auth reply=control.AuthOK state=2

cases.name: auth-wrong
cases.client_output:
CLIENT reply=ACCEPT protocol=1
CLIENT reply=ERROR code=5 message="authentication failed"
cases.server_output:
SERVER received=control.Hello reply=control.Accept state=1
SERVER received=control.Auth reply=control.Error state=3

scope: M3B auth state only; no username/password, keepalive, reconnect, TUN, FEC or carrier changes
